evals.prompt: Use the developing-skills skill to audit this skill.
expected_behavior: Loads SKILL.md and routes to workflows/audit-skill.md.
Uses the current working directory as the target skill when it is clearly a skill repo.
Reports concrete findings with file and line references.
Does not modify files unless the user asks for fixes.

evals.prompt: Create a new skill for extracting renewal-risk signals from customer success notes.
expected_behavior: Asks only for missing scope, trigger, output, or success criteria details.
Drafts frontmatter with a gerund-form name and a quoted description that states capabilities and trigger conditions.
Creates XML-first skill structure and includes lightweight eval prompts before declaring the skill done.

evals.prompt: This skill is not loading when I ask agents to review a SKILL.md. Tighten the description.
expected_behavior: Builds should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts with near misses.
Scores candidate descriptions against the trigger eval set.
Changes only the description unless trigger failures reveal a real scope problem.

evals.prompt: Add a workflow to this skill for archiving obsolete knowledge pages.
expected_behavior: Uses the current skill repo without listing all installed skills.
Updates intake, routing, and workflows_index if a workflow is created.
Connects any new knowledge file through required_reading, knowledge_index, or related-page links.

evals.prompt: Make a matrix of the engineering team's skills and seniority.
expected_behavior: Treats 'skills' as human capabilities, not agent skill artifacts.
